crossRefs.note: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there.…
But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son…
While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man…
God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld…
Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t…
God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either…
In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.
But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge…
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

people.name: Herod
people.line: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.

translations.web: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
translations.bsb: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.
translations.kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
translations.asv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
